messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — enterprise customer asked for searchable audit evidence (7 years), BYOK handshake, and SOC2/ISO-ready evidence packages. Need to scope a minimal MVP for Dedicated/Private deployments and agree launch criteria. cc @Diego Ramos @Alex Chen @Monica Patel
Diego Ramos: Quick flag: making everything full-text searchable will blow up indexing costs. Do we actually need full-text, or will structured events suffice?
Alex Chen: From a compliance perspective: evidence must be tamper-evident, include per-tenant access logs, and support customer-managed keys (BYOK). SOC2 will expect clear packaging for auditors. Also legal-hold requirements may require immutability for some tenants.
Monica Patel: Ops constraints: storage + restore costs matter. We can do hot (searchable) + cold (archive) tiers. Query SLA for archive restores will be higher. What search SLA does the customer expect? If >30s we can keep in cold.
Priya Shah: Customer wants: 1) immediate search for last 90 days, 2) 7yr cold archive exportable per-tenant, 3) BYOK with rotation support. Proposed launch criteria: end-to-end export flow, keystore handshake doc, SOC2 evidence checklist, and acceptance tests with a sample tenant.
Diego Ramos: Proposed MVP approach: structured-only index + blobs for large payloads. Store events as small JSONs: {request_id, ts, user_id, model, route, result_hash}. Text artifacts (prompts/outputs) go to blobstore referenced by event. Example config: 
```json
{
  "retention": {"hot_days": 90, "cold_days": 2555},
  "searchable": "structured_only",
  "byok": true
}
```
This keeps indexing bounded and search fast for common queries.
Alex Chen: BYOK details: need KMS API for wrap/unwrap and a key-rotation plan that preserves ability to verify historical evidence (rewrap or maintain old keys in secure escrow only when legally required). Escrow is high friction; prefer customer-managed keys with rotation metadata stored in the evidence package.
Monica Patel: Ops acceptance: search latency <=1s for hot tier, archive restore target <=24h, replay + evidence export verification step, and admin access audit trail. Also need runbook for legal-hold/unseal flow.
Priya Shah: Timeline check — can we ship this MVP in 6 sprints if we scope to structured-only search and defer full-text and escrow? If not, we need to shrink further.
Diego Ramos: 6 sprints seems doable if we commit to: structured index, blobstore export, BYOK handshake (wrap/unwrap), and export CLI. I'll put up a schema PR and rough effort estimates by EOD.
Alex Chen: I'll draft a SOC2/ISO acceptance checklist and the evidence packaging spec (format + verification checks).
Monica Patel: I'll draft the runbook, retention metrics for the console (hot/cold counts), and error SLOs.
infra-bot: Epic created: INF-EVIDENCE-001 (retention+byok+evidence-export) :white_check_mark:
Priya Shah: Awesome — sync Wed 10am to finalize. Action items: Diego = proto/schema, Alex = SOC2 checklist + packaging spec, Monica = runbook + dashboards. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
